uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-4019-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Vigean Graftmage.
When Vigean Graftmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1350-5287-7824.notablePrerequisites: Dihada has at least four loyalty counters on it.
1350-5287-7824.description:
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to reveal the top four cards of your library and put them into your graveyard, and create eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{W}{W}{B}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Dihada from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dihada by paying {1}{R}{W}{B}.
Repeat.

1170-5078-6979-7693.easyPrerequisites:
You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
1170-5078-6979-7693.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-7208-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7208-7297.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3705-5231-5997-7183.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

2350-3165-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2350-3165-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1550-4251-7060.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-4251-7060.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3941-4067-6281-6927.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Damage Control Crew.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Damage Control Crew that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Damage Control Crew from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

147-2921-3890.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
147-2921-3890.description:
Cast Unearth by paying {B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}. 
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unearth.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unearth, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Unearth copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

539-3043-4657.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
539-3043-4657.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Axebane Guardian.
Repeat.

600-2369-4329.notablePrerequisites: Jace has at least five loyalty counters on it.
600-2369-4329.description:
Activate Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two token copies of Jace that aren't legendary, which each enter the battlefield with four loyalty counters on them due to Oath of Gideon.
Activate a Jace token's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate a Jace token's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two token copies of Jace that aren't legendary, which each enter the battlefield with four loyalty counters on them due to Oath of Gideon.
Repeat from step 2.
600-2369-4329.notes: You may use the infinite Jace tokens to get infinite Illusion creature tokens.

56-3220-4976-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-3220-4976-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Open the Graves and Golgari Germination trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-3220-4976-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

640-2034-4417-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
640-2034-4417-5944.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher, adding {C}{C}.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability and Dross Harvester's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Unstoppable Slasher trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {2} and 2 life, removing both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher and giving Hex Parasite +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wight of the Reliquary

2178-2783-5627.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2783-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2178-2783-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

215-2404-3464-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other creatures.
215-2404-3464-4644.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers itself, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Tidewater Minion any number of times.

1409-4067-5376.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Atraxa.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1409-4067-5376.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Atraxa by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Atraxa enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Atraxa.
Resolve the Atraxa trigger, revealing the top ten cards of your library and putting as many cards as possible from among them into your hand.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
NOTE: This combo has a chance of failure if every card revealed by Atraxa has only one supertype, and all the cards share the same supertype. You can use extra cards from previous iterations to bypass this until your deck is empty, you run out of cards and/or you run out of mana.

687-1451-1628-2034.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Tayam.
Pyreheart Wolf does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
687-1451-1628-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its undying ability and Necrosynthesis trigger.
Resolve the Pyreheart Wolf trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Necrosynthesis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Tayam, and both counters from Pyreheart Wolf.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Pyreheart Wolf from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1274-4186-4716.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4186-4716.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1447-2034-4452.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Angel of Glory's Rise, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, then returning all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

579-2054-3793-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Apprentice Wizard.
Apprentice Wizard does not have summoning sickness.
579-2054-3793-4222.description:
Activate Apprentice Wizard by paying {U} and tapping it, adding six {C}.
Activate Urn of Godfire's first ability by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

1765-2558-3983-4659.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro's first ability.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, causing target player to mill three cards.
Resolve the Chishiro trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token that enters as a 1/1 due to Night of Souls' Betrayal.
The Spirit enters the battlefield, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Spirit token.
Repeat from step 2.

1235-1718-4863-5026.description:
Cast Twinflame with Strive by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting Revolutionist and Catalyst Elemental.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying {R}{R}, creating a copy of Twinflame.
Resolve the Twinflame copy, creating a token copy of Revolutionist and Catalyst Elemental.
Revolutionist enters the battlefield triggers, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to hand.
Holding priority, activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1952-2059.notablePrerequisites: Livio does not have summoning sickness.
1952-2059.description:
Pay {1}{W} to exile Village Bell-Ringer with a aegis counter.
Pay {2}{W} and tap Livio to return Village Bell-Ringer to the battlefield untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
